memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Atrial fibrillation and migraine.
Patient reports occasional palpitations and mild headache. Examination: regular irregular pulse, BP 138/84, lungs clear, no focal neurology. Smoking status: never. No inhaler use.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
apixaban 5 mg BD
bisoprolol 2.5 mg OD
propranolol 40 mg OD
topiramate 25 mg HS
sumatriptan 50 mg SOS
naproxen 500 mg SOS

memories.author: D05
memories.text: ECG: Atrial fibrillation with ventricular rate 78 bpm. No acute ST‑T changes. QRS duration 92 ms.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Atrial fibrillation and migraine – stable.
Patient denies dyspnea or chest pain. Headache frequency reduced to 2 days/month on propranolol. Smoking status: never. Inhaler technique not applicable.

Atrial fibrillation – INR subtherapeutic.
Patient asymptomatic. Migraine well controlled on propranolol. Smoking status: never. Plan: increase warfarin dose.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: Via clinic app: ‘I have felt a bit short of breath when walking to the market and noticed occasional fluttering in my chest.’

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Atrial fibrillation with mild exertional dyspnea.
Exam: regular irregular pulse, BP 140/86, lungs clear, no edema. Migraine controlled. Smoking status: never. Plan: optimize anticoagulation.

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
INR: 2.2 (target 2.0–3.0)
Serum creatinine: 0.9 mg/dL
TSH: 2.0 µIU/mL

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Echocardiogram: Mild left atrial enlargement, left ventricular ejection fraction 60%, no significant valvular disease.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Referral to Cardiology, Dr. K. Rao, for review of atrial fibrillation management and consideration of ablation.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Cardiology review: Agrees with current warfarin therapy, INR therapeutic. No procedural intervention advised at this time. Continue follow‑up in pulmonology clinic.

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Appointment booked for 2026-02-15 at 10:00 with Dr Menon for routine review.
